newsAll.head: Caleb Williams: May miss multiple games with Grade 2 strain
newsAll.body: Williams, who is ruled out for Monday's game against the Eagles, has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, which doctors consider a 3-to-4-week injury, Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport of ESPN report.

newsAll.head: Tyjae Spears: Uncertain about active status
newsAll.body: Spears (ankle) will be monitored by the Titans pregame before Sunday's contest at the Giants, but the team is hopeful he'll be able to play, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

newsAll.head: Puka Nacua: Health concern considered 'short term'

newsAll.head: Jaylen Warren: Likely to play Sunday
newsAll.body: Warren (shoulder), who is listed as questionable for Week 3, is expected to play Sunday versus the Bengals, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

newsAll.head: Michael Pittman: Slated to play Sunday
